status_summary: ETA proposed on 2025-08-29 (90 FR 42143) to require state UC agencies to disclose confidential UC information to federal officials, including the DOL Inspector General, for oversight and audits. The final rule (91 FR 58593, published 2026-09-16) removes the permissive disclosure provision at 20 CFR 603.5(i), adds mandatory disclosure at 603.6(c) and makes the disclosures chargeable to state administrative grants; it takes effect 2026-11-16, and states that must change their laws have until 2027-09-16. It relies on the methods-of-administration requirement in section 303(a)(1) of the Social Security Act rather than the new statute the Mandate asks Congress to enact, so it is an executive step parallel to that request, and the rule does not address the new-hire crossmatch or graduated enforcement tools. No enacted statute on these items was found in a limited search, and the DOL review of fraud-related procurements and state monitoring was not researched.

timeline.event: ETA published a proposed rule to make disclosure of confidential UC information to federal officials, including DOL's Office of Inspector General, mandatory for states.

title: Strengthen unemployment insurance program integrity and federal data access
uncertainties: The final rule was read on federalregister.gov in full as rendered (the rendering is marked unofficial); it contains no National Directory of New Hires crossmatch, graduated-sanction or enforcement-tool provision and does not create a national claims database. Citations: proposed rule 90 FR 42143 (comments closed 2025-09-29); final rule 91 FR 58593, RIN 1205-AC11, docket ETA-2025-0004. Existing law on new-hire crossmatching was not checked. One web search on legislation for Inspector General access and new-hire crossmatching surfaced only a 2024 Senate Finance bill summary from before the review period and no enacted law; this is a limited search. The DOL review of American Rescue Plan Act fraud-prevention procurements and state monitoring is internal and was not checked. Stage judgment: in_progress 25 would apply if the rule were read as a direct match, because a final rule not yet effective is in_progress; proposed is used because the text frames Inspector General access as a statutory change for Congress.
